description: This file contains unit tests for the Note object in the SuiteCRM project, verifying instantiation, attribute values, method behaviors, and ACL permissions.

classes.name: NoteTest
classes.description: A test suite class for testing the behaviors and attributes of the Notes module's Note object.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up a mock current user and configuration.

methods.name: testNote
methods.description: Verifies the proper instantiation of the Note object and its core attributes.

methods.name: testsafeAttachmentName
methods.description: Tests the safeAttachmentName method for handling valid and invalid filenames.

methods.name: testmark_deleted
methods.description: Ensures the mark_deleted method works without exceptions.

methods.name: testdeleteAttachment
methods.description: Tests that deleteAttachment method returns true.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Validates that get_summary_text returns correct summaries based on the note's name.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Checks the SQL query generated by create_export_query with different parameters.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies the output of get_list_view_data contains correct data.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Checks the correct ACL helper permissions array.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests the bean_implements method for various permissions.
